code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (low pH, low O2 saturation, low pO2), leukopenia, neutropenia, lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, and elevated D-dimer, ferritin, LDH, INR, and basophils. These findings suggest acute severe systemic inflammation, possible sepsis or severe viral infection (e.g., COVID-19), and coagulopathy. Immediate clinical evaluation and intervention are recommended.
